quotes.text: Again : Moses and Aaron had been 'called of God to lead the children of Israel. Korah, a Levite, with Dathan, Abiram, and On, descendants of Reuben, took men, and, with two hundred and tfifty princes of the assembly, famous in the congregation, men of renown, gathered themselves together against Mos

This section indicates that neither the Reubenites nor the Korahites died out, despite the deaths of Korah and of Dathan and Abiram and their families. This passage follows the tradition that Korah also perished in the quake
quotes.speaker: Jacob Milgrom
quotes.attr: Jacob Milgrom, The JPS Torah Commentary: Numbers, Philadelphia, 1989, 221
